commit.message:
common.xml: specify character encoding for parameter id fields (#2602)

Annotate param_id in the PARAM_* and PARAM_EXT_* messages as 7-bit ASCII,
and note that PARAM_EXT_*.param_value carries raw bytes interpreted
according to param_type rather than a text string.

Documentation only: no wire format or field type changes.

Part of #2366.
